purpose: Which deployed Power Automate flow each internal package is pasted into. Derived by joining docs/reference/internal-flow-register.json to the built FLOW_CATALOGUE.json on the 32-hex workflow id, then reading the flow name the catalogue records for it.
credentialPolicy: Workflow ids and flow names only. A signed trigger URL is a bearer credential and appears nowhere here, though the catalogue this was derived from holds them.

targets.flow: SINGLE ASSIGN / create task and update activity
**UNRESOLVED — read it off the configured URL before pasting.** Open the `EMAIL` entry in `config/config.local.js` and take its `workflows/<32-hex>/` segment; that is the flow.
targets.evidence: Two attributions exist in this repository and they disagree. docs/reference/flow-list-map.json maps EMAIL to the Universal Dynamic Multi-Actions Executor (workflow bc83d98acf474a088832d78f50085388) because config/endpoints.config.js gives the contract sourceKey "DYNAMIC_GLOBAL_ACTIONS". But EndpointUrls.EMAIL is its own separately configured URL, and the only deployed flow whose body dispatches mail is Web - Send Email (internal name e5e2c6a2-52ea-2ba8-b0b3-60f25d43387f, three SendEmailV2 actions), whose id is recorded against no endpoint key. Neither reading is settled by evidence held here; the URL the operator has configured settles it and nothing else can.
